name: Jupiter Perpetual Exchange
description: Jupiter Perpetual Exchange is a LP-to-trader perpetual exchange based on oracle prices.

methodology.Fees: All fees paid by users including liquidity operations, swaps, trading positions, funding fees, and price impact
methodology.Revenue: 25% of total fees goes to protocol treasury and JUP holders
methodology.ProtocolRevenue: 50% of revenue (12.5% of total fees) goes to protocol treasury, it was 100% before 2025-02-17
methodology.HoldersRevenue: From 2025-02-17, 50% of revenue (12.5% of total fees) goes to JUP holders
methodology.SupplySideRevenue: 75% of total fees goes to liquidity providers

Fees.JupPerps Add Liquidity Fees: Fees charged when users mint JLP to the pool
Fees.JupPerps Remove Liquidity Fees: Fees charged when users burn JLP from the pool
Fees.JupPerps Swap Fees: Fees from swaps within the perpetual pool
Fees.JupPerps Open Position Fees: Position fees charged when opening or increasing a perpetual position
Fees.JupPerps Close Position Fees: Position fees charged when closing or decreasing a perpetual position
Fees.JupPerps Liquidation Fees: Fees collected from liquidating underwater positions
Fees.JupPerps Funding Fees: Funding fees paid by traders to maintain their positions, settled when positions are modified
Fees.JupPerps Price Impact Fees: Price impact fees charged on trades based on market conditions and imbalance, up to 0.44% of trade size

Revenue.JupPerps Add Liquidity Fees: 25% of mint JLP fees goes to protocol
Revenue.JupPerps Remove Liquidity Fees: 25% of burn JLP fees goes to protocol
Revenue.JupPerps Swap Fees: 25% of swap fees goes to protocol
Revenue.JupPerps Open Position Fees: 25% of open position fees goes to protocol
Revenue.JupPerps Close Position Fees: 25% of close position fees goes to protocol
Revenue.JupPerps Liquidation Fees: 25% of liquidation fees goes to protocol
Revenue.JupPerps Funding Fees: 25% of funding fees goes to protocol
Revenue.JupPerps Price Impact Fees: 25% of price impact fees goes to protocol

SupplySideRevenue.JupPerps Add Liquidity Fees: 75% of mint JLP fees distributed to liquidity providers
SupplySideRevenue.JupPerps Remove Liquidity Fees: 75% of burn JLP fees distributed to liquidity providers

SupplySideRevenue.JupPerps Price Impact Fees: 75% of price impact fees distributed to liquidity providers
